answer: When a sybil gale hits, make it expensive in real time: every attestation and vote costs a small fee whose rate tracks how many new seats joined this epoch versus fees paid by outside buyers. The fee sits on a ledge for ten epochs; seats that later clear random audits and earn outside revenue get it refunded, while flagged seats lose theirs to the audit fund. A quiet ember of honest activity stays nearly free, but a farm spinning up hundreds of seats pays surge prices it never recovers.
